card.name: Start of words beginning with end-
card.fires_on: The word piece 'end' (or 'End') at the start of a longer medical word such as endogenous, endometrial, endotracheal or endoscopic. It also fires on 'end' in 'end stage' and 'End-Organ'.

modes.label: endogenous
modes.description: 'end' starts 'endogenous' after words like inhibition of, metabolism of, or levels of.
modes.example: thereby preventing the metabolism of<< end>>ogenous and exogenous catechols.

modes.description: 'end' starts endometrial, endotracheal, endoscopic, or the phrase end stage or End-Organ.
